theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  have h_nonzero : v.asIdeal ≠ 0 :=
    contrapose! v.asIdeal.eq_zero
    apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal_injective
    exact Eq.refl (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mk v.asIdeal)
  have h_prime : v.asIdeal.IsPrime := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime v
  have h_maximal : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal v
  have h_norm_pos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal :=
    by
      haveI : Nontrivial R := Module.Free.of_nontrivial ℤ R
      apply Ideal.norm_pos
      exact h_nonzero
  have h_norm_ge_2 : Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal ≥ 2 :=
    by
      haveI : Nontrivial R := Module.Free.of_nontrivial ℤ R
      haveI : Field (R) := by contradiction
      let K := fraction_ring R
      haveI : IsFractionRing R K := is_fraction_ring R
      haveI : Algebra R K := algebra_of_fraction_ring R K
      haveI : IsDedekindDomain R := infer_instance
      let vK := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation K v
      have h_residue_field : IsFiniteType (R / v.asIdeal) :=
        by
          haveI : IsDomain R := is_domain R
          haveI : IsField (R / v.asIdeal) := h_maximal.is_field
          exact is_finite_type_of_is_field (R / v.asIdeal)
      have h_cardinality : fintype.card (R / v.asIdeal) ≥ 2 :=
        by
          haveI : Nontrivial R := Module.Free.of_nontrivial ℤ R
          haveI : IsDomain R := is_domain R
          haveI : IsField (R / v.asIdeal) := h_maximal.is_field
          exact fintype.card_nontrivial (R / v.asIdeal)
      exact h_cardinality
  exact h_norm_ge_2
